summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Gapless app. Backend has 28 passing pytest tests. Frontend testing covered all major flows: Demo controls, Dashboard, Plan page with 4 action cards, Approve all flow, Demo next progression showing 'Covered ✓' status, Threads page, public offer page, Outbox, Activity, Settings, Buy page, More page, and mobile responsive testing. One minor issue found and FIXED: Footer was missing data-testid attribute on public offer page.
